verdict.rationale: Braintrust documents some operations that act on many items at once: downloading logs in bulk as CSV or JSON, pulling them locally with `bt sync pull`, and Topics automatically classifying every trace. However, the evidence never describes a general bulk-action feature for selecting many items and applying one edit, tag, delete, or move. Missing for 10: documented multi-select bulk edit/tag/delete of logs or dataset rows, bulk actions via API/CLI/MCP, documented limits or scale, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Download logs as CSV or JSON, or pull them locally with `bt sync pull`.
Topics automatically analyze and classify your logs without manual review.
Topics continuously clusters every trace against them.
